description: Fresh held-out start states for Gen-v3, written before any Gen-v3 training episode was planned. Seeds 8000+ were never used before. Sets Q1-Q10 are flown in the Depot (scene C), where no training or validation episode exists; QS is flown in the two training scenes in a layout that is never trained on.

levels.Q1: the blue pad as the thing to find
levels.Q2: a red pad in the first view
levels.Q3: a blue cylinder or a blue cube in the first view
levels.Q4: the Q2 and Q3 poses with the two objects exchanged
levels.Q5: four poses, each told to find four different objects
levels.Q6: six poses, each told to land, to approach, and to find and approach (unseen words)
levels.Q8: the canonical mission: find the blue landing pad and land on it
levels.Q8R: the same mission on the red pad
